top_signals.title: Russia hits train on Ukraine’s border with Poland, just missing ‘diplomatic train’
top_signals.summary: The train, on a route frequently used by foreign delegations returning from Kyiv, was attacked just 2 kilometers from the Polish border.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Artificial Intelligence Consortium minutes – June 2026
top_signals.summary: The Artificial Intelligence Consortium (AIC) aims to provide a platform for public-private engagement to further dialogue on the capabilities, development, deployment, use, and potential risks of artificial intelligence (AI) in UK financial services.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.summary: The Florida Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles (FLHSMV) has confirmed that its DAVID driver database suffered a data breach, saying the attackers gained access using credentials belonging to a police department employee. [...]

top_signals.title: Activities of U.S. Affiliates of Foreign Multinational Enterprises, 2024
top_signals.summary: Majority-owned U.S. affiliates of foreign multinational enterprises employed 8.57 million workers in the United States in 2024, a 0.2 percent increase from 8.56 million workers in 2023, according to statistics on U.S. affiliate operations and finances released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis. top_signals.title: Mizuho’s first female wealth manager head seeks sixfold growth
top_signals.summary: Tomoko Hama is tasked with increasing the value of assets the company advises clients on to more than ¥100 billion in five years.

top_signals.title: Congo’s worst-ever Ebola epidemic passes 7,000 cases
top_signals.summary: Authorities suggested the spread of the disease may already have peaked, despite the virus having been confirmed in a seventh province recently.
